corrected_content.problem:
Determine the Cartesian equation of the circle

$$
\displaystyle x = 9\cos θ - 3, y = 9\sin θ + 5, 0 \le θ < 2π.
$$
corrected_content.worked_solution:
Eliminating the parameter gives
$$(x+3)^2+(y-5)^2=9^2(\cos^2t+\sin^2t)=81.$$
This is a circle centered at $(-3,5)$ with radius $9$.
